description: Source code for the Playwright Recorder, a component that captures user interactions, manages recording modes, handles page events, and communicates with the debugger and other components to facilitate automated testing and recording of browser interactions.

classes.name: Recorder
classes.description: Main class managing recording sessions, handling page events, user interactions, debugger state, and emitting recorder events.

methods.name: forContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Recorder instance for a given browser context.

methods.name: existingForContext
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Recorder instance for a given browser context, if any.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate and initialize a Recorder.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the recorder's mode (e.g., recording, standby).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resumes the debugger, effectively closing the recorder.

methods.name: setHighlightedSelector
methods.description: Highlights a specific selector in the UI.

methods.name: setHighlightedAriaTemplate
methods.description: Highlights an ARIA template in the UI.

methods.name: updateCallLog
methods.description: Updates the call log with current call metadata.
